text:
rina: quick note from onboarding: dotnet-sdk JSON-mode fncall helper is turning arrays into singletons when schema is union[array,object] and model returns an empty-string for the array branch ("\"\"") , causing sample-app handlers to treat it as a valid item and later crash.

jasper: hmm can you paste minimal schema + raw output?

rina: trimmed schema:```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties":{
    "payload":{
      "oneOf":[
        {"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},
        {"type":"object","properties":{"meta":{"type":"string"}}}
      ]
    }
  }
}
```
raw model response: `{"payload":""}` (note empty string, not null). dotnet normalizer coerced `""` -> `[""]` to satisfy array branch.

olivia: that's surprising. Why prefer array over object? Is there a branch-ranking heuristic?

jasper: sdk picks first matching branch and will attempt light coercions (string -> singleton array) for old compat reasons. That heuristic is causing harm here.

tom: do we have a policy doc about what coercions are allowed in JSON-mode? I thought JSON-mode should be strict by default.ina: agreed. we had a compatibility flag in older SDKs to allow scalar->array coercion, but sample-apps onboarding rely on strict preservation to avoid surprises.

jasper: patch plan: add strictJsonMode flag defaulting to true for all new installs. When strictJsonMode=true, normalizer should NOT coerce scalar->array or fabricate objects; instead return the literal value and let the application handle validation fail/uplift. Also add explicit opt-in for legacy scalar->array coercion.

olivia: add unit test covering union[array,object] with empty-string, number, and null -> expect literal values preserved under strict mode. Also add an integration smoke that runs sample-app onboarding flow in strict mode.

tom: ping eng-runtime and sample-app owners in case they rely on old behavior. Might need a brief migration note.

rina: PR opened: https://git.redwood/s/sdk-dotnet/strict-jsonmode-normalizer (WIP) 

sdk-bot: CI queued for PR strict-jsonmode-normalizer — build 9021. See logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/9021

jasper: tiny note: ensure CLI docs + quickstart mention how to toggle strictJsonMode for backwards compat. Also bump minor semver since behavior changes.

olivia: recommend we release patch to sample-app templates first so users get strict-by-default starter kits. Then ship sdk minor.

rina: added changelog entry and a migration snippet. Will add a telemetry metric to track how many responses would have been coerced under legacy rules for 2 weeks (opt-in by default to collect).

tom: nice. helps measure impact before forcing migrations.

rina: CI green. merged and released dotnet-sdk v1.12.0 with strictJsonMode default true. rolling update to onboarding templates completed.

jasper: great work. follow-up: audit other SDK normalizers for similar scalar->container coercions (py, js, go). File: DEVEX-3516 to track parity.

olivia: added DEVEX-3516 and assigned to sdk-parity squad.

rina: closing thread. thanks team :sparkles:
